name: Can mold grow in the walls without being visible?

mainEntity.name: Can mold grow in the walls without being visible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, mold can very easily grow inside walls without any visible signs on the exterior surface. This often happens after a plumbing leak, roof leak, or flood where water enters the wall cavity and gets trapped, creating a dark, damp environment ideal for mold growth. While you might not see it, you may detect a persistent musty odor. Signs like peeling paint, bubbling wallpaper, or water stains appearing on the wall can indicate hidden mold or moisture issues within the wall structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, mold can grow unseen inside walls after water damage, often indicated by a musty smell, peeling paint, or bubbling wallpaper, even without visible surface mold.
